user.title: Add Navien Smart
user.description:
Connect your Navien Smart account and discover heating mats.

Some models support dual-zone (left/right) control and some only support single-zone control.
Some models/devices support operation beep and some may ignore it.

data_description.auth_mode: Choose account login or token login.
data_description.username: Navien Smart login ID. Used in both account mode and token mode.
data_description.refresh_token: Required only in token mode. Account mode can auto-fill this after login.
data_description.account_seq: Required only in token mode. Numeric value from your Navien account data.
data_description.separate_control: When enabled, dual-zone models are exposed as separate left/right climate entities.
data_description.sound_enabled: Send beep flag when changing settings. Devices without beep support may ignore this.
data_description.scan_interval: Periodic refresh interval. Lower values update faster but increase API traffic.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to Navien API
error.invalid_account_seq: Account sequence must be a number
error.missing_password: Password is required in account mode
error.missing_refresh_token: Refresh token is required in token mode
error.missing_account_seq: Account sequence is required in token mode

init.title: Navien Smart options
init.description: Adjust optional behavior. Dual-zone and beep behavior may vary by model.

data_description.separate_control: Enable if your device supports left/right zone control.
data_description.sound_enabled: Enable only if your model supports operation beep.
data_description.scan_interval: How often Home Assistant refreshes device data.
